{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_fsm_sync (
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input start,
    input [7:0] data_in,
    output reg [7:0] data_out,
    output reg done
);

localparam [8:0] S_IDLE  = 9'b000000001;
localparam [8:0] S_START = 9'b000000010;
localparam [8:0] S_READ  = 9'b000000100;
localparam [8:0] S_PROC1 = 9'b000001000;
localparam [8:0] S_PROC2 = 9'b000010000;
localparam [8:0] S_PROC3 = 9'b000100000;
localparam [8:0] S_WAIT  = 9'b001000000;
localparam [8:0] S_DONE  = 9'b010000000;
localparam [8:0] S_ERROR = 9'b100000000;

reg [8:0] state, next_state;
wire read_match = (data_in[3:1] == 3'b101);
wire error_clear = &data_in[2:0];
wire [7:0] incremented;
wire [7:0] shifted;
wire pass_enable;

assign incremented[0] = ~data_in[0];
assign incremented[1] = data_in[1] ^ data_in[0];
assign incremented[2] = data_in[2] ^ (&data_in[1:0]);
assign incremented[3] = data_in[3] ^ (&data_in[2:0]);
assign incremented[4] = data_in[4] ^ (&data_in[3:0]);
assign incremented[5] = data_in[5] ^ (&data_in[4:0]);
assign incremented[6] = data_in[6] ^ (&data_in[5:0]);
assign incremented[7] = data_in[7] ^ (&data_in[6:0]);
assign shifted = {data_in[6:0], 1'b0};
assign pass_enable = state[2] | state[7];

always @* begin
    next_state = 9'b0;
    next_state[0] = (state[0] & ~start) |
                    state[7] |
                    (state[8] & error_clear);
    next_state[1] = state[0] & start;
    next_state[2] = (state[1] & data_in[0]) |
                    (state[6] & data_in[4]);
    next_state[3] = state[2] & read_match;
    next_state[4] = state[3];
    next_state[5] = state[4] & data_in[7];
    next_state[6] = (state[2] & ~read_match) |
                    (state[4] & ~data_in[7]) |
                    (state[6] & ~data_in[4]);
    next_state[7] = state[5];
    next_state[8] = (state[1] & ~data_in[0]) |
                    (state[8] & ~error_clear);
end

always @* begin
    data_out = ({8{pass_enable}} & data_in) |
               ({8{state[3]}} & incremented) |
               ({8{state[4]}} & shifted) |
               ({8{state[5]}} & ~data_in) |
               ({8{state[8]}} & 8'hEE);
    done = state[7];
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst)
        state <= S_IDLE;
    else
        state <= next_state;
end

endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline paths include wide state decoding followed by transition selection or output selection. The state-to-output path is almost as limiting as the state-to-state path, so optimizing only the transition logic would provide little overall benefit.",
  "rewrite": "Keep the original nine one-hot state encodings and state/next_state names, but express transitions directly as one-hot Boolean equations. Replace decoded output selection with parallel masked terms. Express the modulo-256 increment using prefix reductions to avoid requiring a serial carry chain.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected improvement comes from removing full-vector state equality decoders from both transition and output paths. No mapped timing result is available for this candidate; the WNS gain must be established by the specified synthesis and STA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Retains nine state flip-flops and adds no pipeline stages or helper modules. Decoder removal should reduce combinational area, although prefix-increment mapping and buffering remain tool-dependent. Compliance with the 1102.432320um2 cap and electrical limits requires measurement.",
  "functional_boundaries": "The first asserted synchronous reset establishes S_IDLE independently of all initial state bits. Every subsequent transition preserves the one-hot invariant, including repeated resets, so the equations preserve all compared cycle-by-cycle outputs, combinational data dependence, and latency under the stated sampling contract. Idle, start, and wait still output zero; arithmetic truncates to eight bits. Unreachable zero-hot or multi-hot internal states do not retain the reference case-default recovery behavior; this candidate relies only on the explicitly guaranteed first-sample reset, not on any additional input or startup assumption."
}
